shortDescription: Tests reachability using ping from Ruckus ICX 7000 series switches

options.name: count
options.description: Number of packets to send. Default is 1.

options.name: dest
options.description: ip-addr | host-name | vrf vrf-name | ipv6 [ ipv6-addr | host-name | vrf vrf-name]  (resolvable by switch) of the remote node.

options.name: size
options.description: Specifies the size of the ICMP data portion of the packet, in bytes. This is the payload and does not include the header. The value can range from 0 to 10000. The default is 16..

options.name: source
options.description: IP address to be used as the origin of the ping packets.

options.name: state
options.description: Determines if the expected result is success or fail.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Specifies the time, in milliseconds for which the device waits for a reply from the pinged device. The value can range from 1 to 4294967296. The default is 5000 (5 seconds).

options.name: ttl
options.description: Specifies the time to live as a maximum number of hops. The value can range from 1 to 255. The default is 64.

options.name: vrf
options.description: Specifies the Virtual Routing and Forwarding (VRF) instance of the device to be pinged.
